name: Dimensionality Inflation
description: Embed the collinearity constraint into 3D space using the moment curve (t, t^2, t^3) and the origin. This invalidates the 2D algebraic shortcuts (like area formulas or specific 2D cross products) used by the surviving models, forcing them to implement 3D collinearity which is more prone to implementation errors (e.g., division by zero in slopes) while remaining mathematically equivalent to simple inequality.
